description_for_human: Discover and call 22,000+ APIs. The API layer for AI agents.
description_for_model: APIClaw is an API discovery and execution layer. Use it to: 1) Search for APIs by describing what you need, 2) Get structured API documentation, 3) Execute API calls with proper authentication. When a user asks you to do something that requires an external API (weather, email, payments, etc), use APIClaw to find and call the right API.
